description: Report conversions to X server-side (the X Conversion API) — purchases, sign-ups, leads — so X attributes them to the ads that caused them and conversion bidding (goal WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS_V2) has something to optimise toward. pixelId and each eventId come from X Events Manager. Each event needs a click id (twclid from the landing URL), an email or an E.164 phone — emails and phones are SHA-256 hashed on Hermoso's server; IP + user agent only count together or beside one of those. Send conversionId to deduplicate against the X Pixel. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

eventId.description: default Event ID for every event

events.description: conversion events to report, one entry per purchase, sign-up or lead

conversionId.description: dedup key shared with the X Pixel

email.description: email address; normalised and SHA-256 hashed on Hermoso's server

eventId.description: event id for this one event; overrides the top-level eventId

eventSourceUrl.description: URL of the page where the conversion happened

ipAddress.description: visitor IP address; counts only with userAgent or an email or phone

numberItems.description: number of items in the conversion

phone.description: phone in E.164 form, e.g. +14155550100; hashed before sending

twclid.description: X click id from the landing URL's twclid parameter

userAgent.description: visitor browser user agent; counts only with ipAddress or an email or phone

value.description: conversion value in the currency given by currency

pixelId.description: the X Pixel (event source) id from Events Manager

name: send_x_ads_conversions
title: Send conversions to X (Conversion API)
